messages.subject: Nei's distance matrix
parts:
Hi,
I used "poppr" package to get Nei's distances of a population x loci (frequencies) matrix. I checked the Nei's distances obtained by the GenAlEx and I realized that they differ. As a result, the UPGMA I get at the end differs significantly!
Why these two ways of Nei's distances calculation differ?

Thanks in advance for any consideration!
Spyros

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Nei's distance matrix
parts:
Hi,

This is quite strange. Can you provide a reproducible example? One way to do this would be to use a data set already in poppr, exporting it to genalex format:

library("poppr")
data(Pram)
genind2genalex(Pram, "/path/to/pram.csv")

Thanks,
Zhian
